operation.instructions: Given `task` and `files[0].hunk`, what should the agent do next?

criteria.EDIT: Change the skill text so agents attach real code slices
criteria.ASK: Ask the human before changing anything
criteria.SKIP: Do nothing; the skill is already clear
criteria.abstain: Not enough in state to decide

edit_target.instructions: If the next operation is EDIT, which observed hunk should be changed? This question chooses only a target; another question chooses the operation.

criteria.none: No offered hunk should be edited

ask_target.instructions: If the next operation is ASK, what should we ask the human? This question chooses only a target; another question chooses the operation.

criteria.scope: Ask whether the skill should stay questions-first
